pddl_problem:
(define (problem task1_abstract)
  (:domain household-multiagent)
  (:objects
    r1 - gripper
    r2 - mobile_light
    r3 - gripper
    r4 - mobile_heavy
    kitchen - room
    living_room - room
    bread - item
    apple - item
    laptop - item
    magazine - item
    remote - item
    cup - item
    fork - item
    spoon - item
  )
  (:init
    (agent-at r1 kitchen)
    (agent-at r2 kitchen)
    (agent-at r3 living_room)
    (agent-at r4 living_room)
    (agent-free r1)
    (agent-free r2)
    (agent-free r3)
    (agent-free r4)
    (can-access r2 kitchen)
    (can-access r2 living_room)
    (can-access r4 kitchen)
    (can-access r4 living_room)
    (object-at bread kitchen)
    (object-at apple kitchen)
    (object-at laptop living_room)
    (object-at magazine living_room)
    (object-at remote living_room)
    (object-at cup kitchen)
    (object-at fork kitchen)
    (object-at spoon kitchen)
  )
  (:goal
    (and
      (is-sliced bread)
      (is-filled cup)
      (is-clean magazine)
      (is-clean remote)
      (is-clean laptop)
    )
  )
)
